notes.content:
Obstacle Course:
-Added dive
-Added sprint
-Removed swingers
-Fixed punchable door scale
-Fixed punchable door randomization
-Added mobs behind each door

Jetpack:
-Changed LookUp to show the character
- bubbles now start but shrinking then growing

Tanks:
-Shots now launch first hit player in the direction of the shot - Test to confirm

Stage Stagger:
-Cannons now launch you in the direction they are moving - Test to confirm

Pick Up Artist:
-Increased base movement speed - makes players movement more fluid and more incentivized to do shorter hoard runs
-Increased jump height to reduce frustration exiting water
-Throwables now launch you in the direction they are moving - Test to confirm
-lowered slowest speed cap - deter player strategy from hoarding birds all game for one big pay off
-Added more projectiles to allow spam throwing to quickly reduce carry load
-carrying birds now impacts air movement speed too
